title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential: The response must give the potential at the corner as Φ ≈ (0.0947 ρ a²)/ε₀ or an equivalent form with the correct constant.

title: Scaling argument setup
description: Important: The solution must state or imply that the potential at the center of the large cube is the sum of contributions from 8 identical sub-cubes with half the side length.

title: Correct scaling relation
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the potentials, writing an equation of the form Φ_center = 8 * Φ_corner(a/2).

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Important: The student must correctly simplify the scaling relation to solve for the unknown constant C.

title: Dimensional consistency
description: Optional: The answer should have the correct dimensions of electric potential (or the student notes the form C ρ a²/ε₀ is dimensionally correct).

title: Incorrect scaling factor
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect factor (e.g., 4 or 2 instead of 8) when summing contributions from sub-cubes.

title: Sign or constant error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final numerical constant is off by a factor (e.g., 0.1894 instead of 0.0947) due to algebraic mistake.
